calls.reason: In December 2025 the ARC Prize Foundation said AGI was 'not yet' here. Musk predicted AGI 'probably next year' in April 2024, then at Davos in January 2026 moved smarter-than-human AI to late 2026, which fits a promise that keeps being repeated.

The arXiv review from February 2026 has Caltech and Stanford authors. It reports that significant reasoning failures persist, including brittleness in o1-mini and difficulties for state-of-the-art reasoning models. Its main limit is that it is a survey drawing partly on studies of older models.
